newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen tribesmen free German hostages - official.
newsitem.headline: Yemen tribesmen free German hostages - official.

text.p: Tribesmen in Yemen on Tuesday released seven German tourists they had been holding for a week, a Yemeni security official said.

He told Reuters a plane left Sanaa for the eastern province of Hadramaut to fly them back to the Yemeni capital. The seven men aged between 30 and 45 were kidnapped last week while riding motorcycles through the Wadi al-Dabaat area between Mahra and Hadramaut provinces.
A security official had said earlier on Tuesday that the kidnappers agreed to release the Germans after a large number of security forces and troops tightened a siege on them.

He would not say if the tribesemen had dropped their demands. The kidnappers wanted to put pressure on the goverment to bring to justice an alleged Yemeni swindler who sold them smuggled cars brought in from Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states.
Yemeni Interior Minister Hussein Mohammad Arab had told the German ambassador on Monday the seven were in good health.
